index.title: Document types
index.hint: Central catalog of document types for license application requirements. Leagues pick from this catalog which documents a license application requires.
index.requestHint: New document types can be requested at sbk@floorball.de.
index.name: Name
index.ageRuleIncomplete: Please enter the value for the selected age rule, otherwise the document type applies to everyone.
index.ageRuleHint: The application date rule counts the exact age on the day of application. The birth year rule covers a whole cohort regardless of birthday and application date, but has to be moved forward each season.
index.requiredBelowAgeHint: Only required if the player is younger at the time of application (e.g. 18).
index.requiredFromBirthYearHint: Required for everyone born in this year or later (e.g. 2012).
index.templateRemoveMarked: Template will be removed on save.
index.deleteInUseHint: This document type is already in use (uploads or league configuration) and cannot be deleted.
